name: multi-sdd-team
principles: The main session is the orchestrator.
The orchestrator classifies first and does not spawn an orchestrator subagent.
After spawning any subagent, the orchestrator waits for the required handoff before the next local or delegated step.
No delegated stage may start until its declared dependencies are complete.
The orchestrator must not inspect, scaffold, implement, or validate locally while subagents are running unless the user explicitly authorizes parallel local work.
Demo-fast mode: run agents in fast mode, skip hacker by default, and let the main orchestrator apply small reviewer-requested fixes directly.

INLINE.description: Small/simple task. Main session implements directly.

sequence.action: Complete the bounded delegated task and return a handoff.
Review the handoff, integrate if needed, and report.

SUBAGENT_CHAIN.description: Clear multi-step work without full SDD.

sequence.action: Read-only reconnaissance. Return relevant files, architecture notes, and start points.
Make the scoped change using the available handoff.
Report-only validation of the implemented change.
Summarize results and perform final integration or small reviewer-requested fixes directly. Do not call implementer again for review fixes in demo-fast mode.

SDD_INLINE.description: SDD justified but small enough for the main session.

sequence.action: Write lightweight spec/plan, implement, and validate inline.

SDD_SUBAGENTS.description: Full SDD flow with strict sequential handoffs.

sequence.action: Inspect codebase, inputs, data shape, dependencies, and risks in read-only mode. Return a compact handoff.
Write functional and technical specs using the explorer handoff. Do not start before explorer returns.
Turn specs into ordered, verifiable implementation tasks. Do not start before documentator returns.

sequence.condition: Skip in demo-fast mode. Run only if the user explicitly asks for security review or the task involves auth, secrets, payments, destructive actions, or external network exposure.
sequence.action: Perform passive security review and return findings before implementation.
Implement according to the planner handoff and any security constraints.
Run report-only static/E2E/manual validation and return findings.
Integrate final results, resolve tester_reviewer findings directly when they are small or demo-blocking, and summarize evidence. Do not call implementer again for review fixes in demo-fast mode.

hard_rules: For SDD_SUBAGENTS, never spawn documentator in parallel with explorer.
For SDD_SUBAGENTS, never spawn planner before documentator returns.
For SDD_SUBAGENTS, never spawn implementer before planner returns.
For SDD_SUBAGENTS, never spawn tester_reviewer before implementer returns.
In demo-fast mode, skip hacker unless explicitly requested by the user or required by sensitive security scope.
In demo-fast mode, if tester_reviewer requests changes, the main session fixes them directly instead of calling implementer again.
If a dependency is optional and skipped, note why it was skipped before continuing.
